summary: A marketing manager used a new unmanaged device, touched production engineering assets for the first time, searched for deployment credentials, and downloaded data from critical storage without a matching ticket or project assignment.
what_changed: New unmanaged device used for successful login
First-time access to production deployment repository
Bulk download from critical object storage
why_unusual: No production repository access in prior 180 days
Peer group rarely accesses cloud storage directly
Activity occurred outside normal working hours
Source network differs from the user's normal geography
recommended_actions: Validate the session with the account owner
Check whether downloaded objects contain credentials
Consider session invalidation and credential rotation
